Degree-set theorem. If A is a set of fewer than N distinct integers in {1,…,N−1}, then there is a simple graph on N vertices whose degree set contains A.

For completeness, its induction proof is as follows. For N=2 it is clear. Assume it for N−1. Given A⊂{1,…,N−1}, first realize A\{N−1} on N−1 vertices by induction and add a new vertex.
